messages.name: Kowalski (NWS ILN)
messages.text: Tornado Warning for central Haldane County until 3:45 PM. Rotating storm near Milford moving northeast at 35 mph.

messages.name: Reyes (Haldane County EMA)
messages.text: Copy. Sirens activated for Milford and Cedar Ridge. Any spotter confirmation?

messages.name: Kowalski (NWS ILN)
messages.text: Spotter reports a tornado on the ground 2 N of Milford. Debris signature on radar.

messages.name: Adler (WHAL-TV)
messages.text: We are cutting in now. Can you confirm 35 mph and a 3:45 expiration?
